2610.04559.title: Coupling Noisy Pairwise Knowledge to the DAG Posterior for Causal Discovery
2610.04559.paper_summary: External causal reports can improve structure learning from limited observations, but their reliability varies across sources and variable pairs. We introduce HB-NoisyKG, a Bayesian framework that combines observational data with repeated causal reports from sources such as large language models. Each report is a noisy observation of a direct pair state implied by one DAG. A feature-conditioned Beta prior pools information about pair reliability, and a shared error matrix captures systematic mistakes. Alternating inference uses the graph posterior to refine reliability estimates, which determine how reports influence subsequent graph updates. The report likelihood uses only graph pair-state marginals, so the same observation layer supports discrete and continuous likelihoods in graph-only and joint inference. Against an 80-restart no-KG baseline, HB uses at most 80 total restarts and lowers mean SHD from 22.39 to 16.06 on five discrete benchmarks. On a physical light tunnel with random variable IDs and retained descriptions, HB lowers SHD from 39.00 for no-KG to 27.30. On continuous Sachs, graph-only BGe raises AUROC by 0.121 over no-KG Top-K. In a controlled synthetic study, continued updating also reduces mean reliability estimation error and held-out report log loss compared with one-time estimation.
2610.04559.paper_summary_zh: 外部因果報告可以改善從有限觀察中學習結構，但其可靠性因來源和變數對而異。我們介紹了 HB-NoisyKG，一個貝葉斯框架，將觀察數據與來自大型語言模型等來源的重複因果報告結合起來。每個報告都是由一個 DAG 所暗示的直接對狀態的噪聲觀察。特徵條件的 Beta 先驗匯集了有關對可靠性的信息，而共享錯誤矩陣則捕捉系統性錯誤。交替推斷使用圖後驗來細化可靠性估計，這決定了報告如何影響後續的圖更新。報告的似然僅使用圖對狀態的邊際，因此相同的觀察層支持在僅圖和聯合推斷中的離散和連續似然。與 80 次重啟的無 KG 基線相比，HB 最多使用 80 次總重啟，並將五個離散基準的平均 SHD 從 22.39 降低到 16.06。在一個具有隨機變數 ID 和保留描述的物理光隧道中，HB 將 SHD 從無 KG 的 39.00 降低到 27.30。在連續 Sachs 中，僅圖的 BGe 將 AUROC 提高了 0.121，相較於無 KG 的 Top-K。在一項受控的合成研究中，持續更新還減少了平均可靠性估計誤差和與一次性估計相比的保留報告對數損失。
2610.04559.author: Guoliang Xu et.al.
